Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2001
PRISONS
BALOCHISTAN AMENDMENT
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Prisons
Act, 1894
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Prisons (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 11 of Act IX of 1894

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2001
PRISONS
BALOCHISTAN AMENDMENT
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Prisons
Act, 1894
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 11 of
Act IX of 1894.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Prisons Act, 1894,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in subsection (2) of section 11, for
the words "District Magistrate" the word "Magistrate" shall
be substituted.
